skill.name: alternative-blog-writer
skill.description: Write informative, simple, and highly SEO-optimized "alternative" or "competitor comparison" blog articles designed to capture organic search traffic for high-volume keywords. Use when the user asks to write a blog post like "Best [Competitor] Alternatives," "[Product] vs [Competitor]," or a roundup of options in a specific category. The skill guides through intake, keyword research, SERP analysis, and structured drafting with GEO/AEO optimization built in.
skill.userDescription: Write SEO-optimized alternative and competitor comparison blog articles to capture organic search traffic.
exampleQuestions: Write a comprehensive blog post comparing Notion with Obsidian as the best productivity alternatives.
Create an SEO-optimized alternative article about top CRM platforms like Salesforce versus HubSpot.
Draft a detailed competitor comparison post highlighting the top alternatives to Shopify for e-commerce.
